period_note: CONSOLIDATED (Group) basis, matching this bank's main Q4/annual series (see sources.json reporting_basis). Source: Southeast Bank's own BSEC-mandated 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' disclosure table, embedded in its annual report (a corporate-governance disclosure most banks answer with a checkbox, but which Southeast Bank answers with an actual Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet-and-income-statement table for that report's own year, plus a comparative column for the prior year). Balance-sheet line items are the 1 January to 30 June 2017 period-end snapshot (basis reported). Income-statement line items and EPS are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY 2017 ("1 January to 30 June 2017" exactly as the table's own column header states), not discrete-quarter figures -- flagged via the _cumulative suffix, basis reported, same convention as CITYBANK. Balance-sheet identity (Total assets = Total liabilities + Total equity) holds to within a consistent ~BDT 8-11m gap (~0.002-0.004% of total assets), most plausibly a small Non-controlling-interest balance not broken out as its own row in this vintage of the table -- see the 2021-2025 vintage, which adds an explicit NCI row and closes this same gap almost exactly. Cumulative net profit after tax increases monotonically Q1->Q2->Q3 within 2017 (validated; no violation). Cross-checked against the FY2018 report's comparative column: all balance-sheet and net-profit figures match exactly for every quarter. EPS diverges: Q1/Q2 EPS (0.96/1.29) are reproduced unchanged, but Q3 EPS is restated 2.58->2.24 and Q4 EPS 1.27->1.11 by the FY2018 report (a share-count basis change). The contemporaneous EPS is kept, consistent with the bank's already-documented FY2017 annual EPS decision (1.27, the figure that reconciles with the reported P/E ratio).
